recipes.name: Greek Lamb and Orzo
ingredients_raw: 1 stalk celery, cut into 1/2 inch pieces

steps.text: Heat a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground lamb in the hot pan until browned, crumbly, and no longer pink, about 5 minutes.

Stir in tomatoes and their juice, celery, orzo, garlic, salt, and cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until orzo is tender and has absorbed liquid from tomatoes, about 12 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Greek Lamb and Orzo
raw_recipe.description: Orzo pasta is simmered with tomatoes and browned lamb in this Greek-inspired dish.

review.reviewBody:
an easy version of a time consuming classic. It's very basic, too. My own version of this has a leg of lamb and uses oregano, lemon, and feta cheese as well as the ingredients you listed. I was taught using the "handful" measuring method, so I'm not sure about quantities. Still, this takes about 1/10 the time and is very tasty :). 

Thank you for sharing! I'll be making this again for sure. Definitely try adding feta if you're looking for suggestions. It does wonders for this recipe.

This was really excellent--simple, quick, and filling. I made exactly as described, but without celery. It turned out perfectly. One note: It may be difficult to find "stewed" tomatoes at your grocery store (it was at mine), so a can of chopped or peeled tomatoes should be a fine substitution.

Oh my goodness! This is entirely too easy to be this tasty. Excellent flavor (I am a savory kinda gal), and super quick and easy to make. I sometimes saute a chopped onion with the celery before browning the meat. Add a salad and voila, the perfect dinner. I am not a big fan of lamb so this recipe was a surprise. Also, a tip for those of you feeding those with sensitive palates, cut back on the cayenne pepper and allow the fire-eaters to add it separately.

We did like it. I added some oregano, parsley, cayenne and onion but, I think I could have gone the other way with cumin or cinnamon and nutmeg even. It is very versatile with seasoning options but, it does need more seasoning and herbs. I also seasoned the meat while cooking as well with salt & pepper. I served it with a lemon slice to brighten and feta.

I made this tonight because ground lamb was on sale at my local store. Never had ground lamb before, but this was a hit! Added salt and pepper to the lamb as I cooked it, also added the calamata olives and a bit of their juice when I added the other ingredients. I used petite diced tomatoes instead of stewed tomatoes and added some extra oregano. Also added a little chicken stock and cooked a bit longer than suggested. Was light on the cayenne as we don't like a lot of spice. I definitely recommend adding some feta on top as it gives a little more saltiness to the dish. My kids loved it and I loved the simplicity of this dish!

Loved it. So quick and easy to make and so few dishes to clean ! I seared sliced mushrooms in oil first, removed from pan, then followed recipe from beginning, adding mushrooms back with the tomatoes. I had to frequently stir the sauce as it simmered, else it stuck to the bottom of the pan. As per other reviews, I added alot (2 tbs) oregano, approx. 1 cup of feta pieces and juice of half lemon. Feta gave it a creamy texture, and lemon just lightened it a little. Delicious.

This was very good and filling but a little fatty for my taste. I should have drained the fat after browning the lamb but since I added chopped onions thought I would need the grease to sauté them. I also added lemon juice, oregano, Italian seasoning and topped with feta and chopped parsley. Served it with a baguette, Greek salad and watermelon/feta salad. Nice combo.

I made it with ground beef and topped with feta and it was delicious. I did add a bit of lemon juice and oregano while it was cooking to give it more flavor. I would probably use diced tomatoes next time rather than stewed tomatoes because the tomato chunks would be smaller that way.
I thought this was delicious and SO simple!! Added some spinach for color. Used Diced tomatos and threw in some greek seasonings I had on hand. YUM!
This is absolutely delicious and so easy to make. We add spinach and a chopped onion when cooking and then sprinkle with feta when we serve it. It's a staple in our house.

Quick, easy, easily found ingredients, and most importantly - YUM! My husband had thirds! You might need to add an additional 1/2-2/3 c. water and cook a bit longer though. I added some kalamata olives, a few Tbsp of olive juice, and pepper as well. Will definitely make again...
excellent! I omit the celery and use goat cheese instead of feta, it’s delicious
Easy and delicious. The hardest part was finding the lamb. The feta added at the end was the icing on the cake. Coupled this with Zoodle Zucchini Salad.

Quick, easy, and reminded my Albanian wife of food from her home. How much more perfect could it be? Followed the recipe as written. Definitely add the Feta cheese and have some good crusty bread to go with it.
I substituted 2 cans of diced tomatoes. It was delicious!
Quick, simple and flavorful. Definitely benefits from some feta cheese crumbles added before serving.
So easy & delicious! I added crumbled feta on top.
I make this all the time. You do need to continually add water to it though so that the orzo doesn't stick. Other than that it's delicious!
Amazing recipe! We let it cool for 3 more min so the orzo had more time to absorb the tomato juice. Also had it with French baguette, delicious!
This has become one of my standby meals. Lamb is a nice change and more economical ground.
